_comment: do.c dropx() and flooreffects() pit arm (289-297): a human Samurai wishes a pit beside the up stairs, steps off and back into it, then floats up out of it with a blessed potion of levitation, so she stands untrapped at a seen pit (uteetering_at_seen_pit()). Polymorphing into a kitten makes polyself.c break_armor() and drop_weapon() drop the splint mail and katana through dropx(); flooreffects() reports each one tumbling into the pit before ordinary placement. Independent of the c-diff-b4 examples.
